gloss: to drizzle in a circular motion; to pour around

definitions.gloss: to drizzle in a circular motion; to pour around
definitions.explanation: To pour a liquid (oil, sauce, dressing) over food while moving the container in a circle so the liquid covers the surface evenly. Common cooking instruction.

examples.japanese: ごま⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}しかける。
examples.english: Drizzle sesame oil around in a circle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しょうゆ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}しかけて⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: At the end, drizzle soy sauce around and turn off the heat.

examples.japanese: {溶|と}き{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外側|そとがわ}→外側：05450_sotogawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧{回|まわ}しかける。
examples.english: Pour the beaten egg in a circular motion from the center of the pan toward the outside.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (to turn) + かける (to pour over). Almost exclusively a cooking term, found in recipes. Conveys both the action of pouring and the circular motion that distributes the liquid evenly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごま⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}しかける: to drizzle sesame oil
- しょうゆ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}しかける: to drizzle soy sauce
- {溶|と}き{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}しかける: to pour beaten egg in a circle
- ⟦ドレッシング→ドレッシング：11126_doresshingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}しかける: to drizzle dressing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- かける: to pour over — general; no implication of circular motion
- ⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to pour — into a container, not over food
